{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Colombia|Cuisine of Colombia]]

'''La mazorca desgranada''' is typical northern Colombian coast fast food recipe. Is is made of sweet corn, beef, cheese, crushed potato chips, and tartar sauce.

==Ingredients==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (250 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] loin steak, cut into thin strips
* [[Cookbook:Tartar Sauce|Tartar sauce]]
* Ground [[Cookbook:Allspice|allspice]]
* Ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Worcestershire Sauce|Worcestershire sauce]]
* ½ small "Summer Crisp" (Batavian) [[Cookbook:Lettuce|lettuce]], thinly [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* ¼ pound (125 g) shredded costeño or [[Cookbook:Monterey Jack Cheese|Monterey Jack]] cheese
* 1 can (15[[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]/425 g) whole kernel [[Cookbook:Corn|corn]]
* Crushed potato chips (crisps)

==Procedure==
# [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] beef in a medium [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]]. Season with allspice, pepper, salt, and Worcestershire sauce.
# Heat corn in warm water, then drain well.
# Place lettuce into serving dish.
# Place corn over the lettuce.
# Add shredded cheese on top of the corn.
# Top with beef.
# Cover everything with crushed potato chips.
# Pour tartar sauce all over the dish, and enjoy.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* This recipe is similar to KFC bowls. You can eliminate beef, or replace it with chicken, bacon, pork, sausage, hot dog, and others. You can also mix tartar sauce with [[Cookbook:Ketchup|ketchup]] and/or [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]].
